description: A Database of Test Results from Steel and Reinforced Concrete Infilled Frame Experiments is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Henry Burton, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). Extensive experimental investigations into the behavior of reinforcement concrete and steel frames with infill have been carried out worldwide. However, there are very few systematically created and publicly available databases on infilled frame experiments. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-g6t9-wx70. Keywords: Masonry Infilled Frames, Database. Published 2019-07-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
